note: Managed tool-runtime download caches (uv / pip / XDG caches, HF_HOME model weights) keyed by runtime dir — TOOL_RUNTIME_DOWNLOAD_CACHE_ROOT / resolveToolRuntimeDownloadCacheDir in libs/core/tool/tool-runtime-policy.ts. Re-generable, but multi-GB weights are downloaded explicitly after a disk-space check and keep their download mtime, so the partition's per-file mtime TTL would tear live Hugging Face snapshot trees; eviction is the operator's call. Never an install target; installs live under active/shared/runtime/tool-runtimes.
